# B02 — Models & Agent Requests (Dev Implementation)

**Status:** Detailed; implement after B01 IDs/Host contracts are available.  
**Outcome:** User cấu hình provider/model, gửi request qua **OpenCode CLI**, nhìn thấy status/activity, Stop, reload UI mà run vẫn tiếp tục; restart Host không auto-run.  
**Specs:** UC-005, UC-003; FR-012–014, FR-018–019, FR-039–046, FR-058–059, FR-065, FR-068, FR-070, FR-076 (approval boundary implemented B03), FR-079, FR-042; BR-005/006/008; NFR-006/011. Read full alternatives before implementation.  
**Decisions:** [ADR-0002](../adr/0002-chat-session-history.md), [0003](../adr/0003-tools-permissions.md), [0004](../adr/0004-request-events-lifecycle.md), [0006](../adr/0006-credentials-models.md).

## 1. Boundaries

**In:** Provider setup/redacted settings, model catalog/manual IDs, chat selection, secret store, per-run config, native session capture/resume, event persistence/streaming, stop and Host restart recovery. **Out:** full attachment/source permissions (B03), slide creation/confirmation (B04), generation quality (B05). Generic Chat request works without Deck generation.

- `ChatId != native OpenCode sessionID`. Chat remains authoritative after native session expires.
- One active request per Chat; other Chats may run concurrently. UI reload/close does not cancel Host process.
- Provider/model/credential settings captured at request admission; live changes affect **future** requests only.
- Request terminal status is decided by Host. `step_finish` alone is not proof of completed Request; failed tool step alone is not fatal.
- No key in SQLite conversation/events, UI payload, artifact, debug config, stderr/error record or committed repo.

## 2. Ownership / reuse

| Owner | Source/strategy |
|---|---|
| `apps/local-web/src/opencode/` | Selectively port `process.ts`, `agent.ts`, `config.ts`, `provider.ts`, `history.ts` from `feat/v2-opencode`; drop custom `@deckagent/agent-runtime` dependencies; **change POC fresh-session-per-turn policy to guarded native resume** |
| `apps/local-web/src/provider-settings.ts` and credential adapter | Adapt current ProviderStore; keep public provider metadata separate from secret bytes |
| `packages/host/api/` | Request admission, Stop, readonly request/activity APIs + streaming transport |
| `packages/session/persistence/` | Chat messages, Request/event records, session binding; do not expose native OpenCode data to UI |
| `packages/client/runtime/` | Render request status, activities and error, replay after reconnect |

## 3. Dev tasks

### B02-IMP-01 — Provider configuration and secrets

- Support built-in IDs `openai`, `anthropic`, `google`, `deepseek` and custom protocols in BR-005. Save config only after provider connection/key check (FR-041); failed validation must preserve existing config. Let user add catalog models and manual ID; no implicit default model.
- Decide and document **OS-specific local credential store** before saving real keys. SQLite stores only nonsecret metadata/reference; secret adapter returns key to authorized run path. If secure persistence is unavailable, reject real-key save with explicit error instead of plaintext fallback.
- Changing/deleting provider or removing model updates future selectable models; active Request keeps its frozen settings. Ensure deleted selected model leaves Chat with no selection (FR-065).
- **Developer checks:** failed key/timeout doesn't overwrite saved config; key absent from DB/log/UI output; custom protocol mapping; catalog unavailable still allows manual model ID; remove/change during active run.

### B02-IMP-02 — CLI adapter and run-scoped config

- Spawn `opencode run --format json` locally without shell interpolation. Supply prompt by stdin when supported; pin tested CLI version/args. Inject provider/env only for this invocation; no global/project OpenCode config mutation. Keep a run-specific managed cwd, **not** user project folder.
- Parse structured JSON lines incrementally, sanitize stderr/errors, bound output and close child/process resources. Failure paths: unavailable CLI, invalid JSON/event, provider error, nonzero exit, timeout, Stop, terminal event mismatch.
- **Developer checks:** adapter tests with fake CLI executable/event fixtures; actual pinned CLI smoke (without asserting feature complete from fixtures alone); no key in trace.

### B02-IMP-03 — Native session mapping + continuity

- First Chat turn: capture OpenCode `sessionID` from events. Save `(chatId, nativeSessionId, model, context/cwd identity, lastCompletedTurnId)` only after valid completion checkpoint; follow-up uses `-s <id>` only if resume guard passes.
- On model/cwd/context change, missing upstream session or stale last turn: use new session with safe context seeding; never replay historical tool calls as commands or inherit grants. Keep full Chat history in DeckAgent SQLite. Keep the current active Request independent of Chat selection changes.
- **Developer checks:** two-turn same Chat uses native resume; Chat A/B remain separate; model change creates fresh native session; missing/stale session preserves UI history; last unfinished request never auto-resumes after restart.

### B02-IMP-04 — Request lifecycle and durable events

- Host admission atomically records user input + Request and locks Chat. Store sanitized `Activity(eventId, requestId, sequence, state, detail)` **before** sending UI updates. Map CLI `step_start`, `step_finish`, `text`, `error` and MCP future events without duplicate completed text.
- UI receives current snapshot + sequence cursor replay, then incremental updates; reconnect must fill gaps. Status supports running, awaiting approval (B03), completed, stopped, failed/unfinished. Failed tool activity does not automatically fail Request.
- Enforce UC-013 A5: reject Workspace removal/relink while any Chat in it has active Request; do not stop it. On Host restart, mark previously active Request unfinished with its persisted completed work; no auto-retry. Context overflow must keep full readable history and surface summary boundary per FR-079; test the implemented compaction policy with the pinned runtime.
- **Developer checks:** event ordering/persistence; reload/reconnect; duplicate event frames; crash/restart; no invented activity; sanitize provider/tool errors.

### B02-IMP-05 — Stop + UI integration

- Stop must signal/terminate child promptly even if provider sends nothing; revoke request-scoped tool bridge when present, settle running activities, preserve any completed output, unlock Chat. Distinguish explicit user Stop from failure/Host restart. Do not resume an explicitly stopped execution; later request is new work.
- Wire provider settings, model selection, Send/status/activities/Stop into existing UI; no redesign. A Chat without selectable model keeps composer draft and displays reason Send is disabled.
- **Developer checks:** hung fake CLI Stop, late event/late callback ignored, UI refresh while Host alive, two Chats running independently, no response when model not configured.

## 4. Developer integration checks

1. Local app → save provider → add/select model → generic Chat request → persisted reply/events → reopen after restart.
2. Same Chat follow-up → correct native `-s`; change model → guarded new session; no duplicate historical tool execution.
3. Stop idle/hung CLI → process ends, Request stopped, further writes rejected; next send new request.
4. Disconnect/reconnect UI → ongoing request lives in Host, persisted events replay with no gap/double count.
5. Bad credential, provider outage, invalid CLI/version → clean error, no raw secret; Chat/request records retained.
6. No concurrent second active request in same Chat; different Chat can run independently.

Run relevant `node --test` integration tests plus `pnpm typecheck`/`pnpm build`. Test with fake CLI for deterministic failures, then smoke with **real pinned OpenCode CLI** and report its version. This is Dev verification, **not** independent UC/STLC testing.

## 5. Dependencies / Dev Done / handoff

- B01 supplies `chatId`, Workspace reference, App Data root, Host transport. IMP-02/03 may be built in parallel with IMP-01 after defining Request/session binding payload; assign one owner to the Host process orchestration file.
- **Blockers:** BR-006 values must be finalized; real keys require safe credential store; unsupported custom protocol cannot silently fall back. B03 supplies secure MCP/approval implementation before enabling tools with filesystem access.
- **Dev Done:** generic request works end-to-end with provider, persistent status/history, native resume guard and Stop/reconnect; unit/integration/real CLI smoke evidence recorded. Handoff to B03: MCP invocation contract, authorization context, run cancellation, event callback and source-free execution environment.
